# OpenBQ Documentation

Source for the OpenBQ documentation site: [docs.openbq.io](https://docs.openbq.io)

OpenBQ is an open-source biometric quality framework. This repository contains the documentation, built with Jekyll and the Just the Docs theme.

## Run locally

```bash
bundle install
bundle exec jekyll serve
```

Then open http://localhost:4000.
